void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool has_text(string[] choices, string value)
    for choice := choices[]
        if choice == value
            return true
    return false

int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b

int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b

int total_ints(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

nat find_text(string text, string needle)
    match text.find(needle)
        nat at
            return at
        none
            return #text

bool natural_token(string value)
    if #value < 1 or #value > 3
        return false
    for: i < #value
        if not "0123456789".contains(value[i])
            return false
    return true

bool positive_token(string value)
    return natural_token(value) and int(value) > 0

bool signed_token(string value)
    return natural_token(if value.starts_with("-") then value[1:] else value)

bool percent_token(string value)
    return value.ends_with("%") and natural_token(value[:<#value - 1])

bool fr_token(string value)
    return value.ends_with("fr") and positive_token(value[:<#value - 2])

map<string, string> default_style()
    map<string, string> result
    names := ["display", "position", "box-sizing", "width", "height", "min-width", "min-height", "max-width", "max-height", "flex-direction", "flex-wrap", "justify-content", "align-items", "align-self", "row-gap", "column-gap", "order", "flex-grow", "flex-shrink", "flex-basis", "grid-template-columns", "grid-template-rows", "grid-column", "grid-row"]
    values := ["block", "static", "content-box", "auto", "auto", "0", "0", "none", "none", "row", "nowrap", "start", "stretch", "auto", "0", "0", "0", "0", "1", "auto", "none", "none", "auto", "auto"]
    for: i < #names
        .result.set(names[i], values[i])
    for side := ["top", "right", "bottom", "left"][]
        .result.set(side, "auto")
        for kind := ["margin", "padding", "border"][]
            .result.set(kind + "-" + side, "0")
    return result

string style_get(map<string, string> values, string prop)
    match values.get(prop)
        string value
            return value
        none
            return ""

bool known_property(string prop)
    return style_get(default_style(), prop) != "" or has_text(["margin", "padding", "border", "gap"], prop)

bool gridline_valid(string[] tokens)
    if #tokens == 1
        return tokens[0] == "auto" or positive_token(tokens[0])
    if #tokens == 2
        return tokens[0] == "span" and positive_token(tokens[1])
    if #tokens == 3
        return positive_token(tokens[0]) and tokens[1] == "/" and positive_token(tokens[2]) and int(tokens[0]) < int(tokens[2])
    if #tokens == 4
        return positive_token(tokens[0]) and tokens[1] == "/" and tokens[2] == "span" and positive_token(tokens[3])
    return false

bool longhand_valid(string prop, string[] tokens)
    if prop == "grid-template-columns" or prop == "grid-template-rows"
        if #tokens == 1 and tokens[0] == "none"
            return true
        for token := tokens[]
            if token != "auto" and not natural_token(token) and not fr_token(token)
                return false
        return true
    if prop == "grid-column" or prop == "grid-row"
        return gridline_valid(tokens)
    if #tokens != 1
        return false
    value := tokens[0]
    if prop == "display"
        return has_text(["block", "flex", "grid", "none"], value)
    if prop == "position"
        return has_text(["static", "relative", "absolute"], value)
    if prop == "box-sizing"
        return has_text(["content-box", "border-box"], value)
    if prop == "flex-direction"
        return has_text(["row", "row-reverse", "column", "column-reverse"], value)
    if prop == "flex-wrap"
        return has_text(["nowrap", "wrap"], value)
    if prop == "justify-content"
        return has_text(["start", "end", "center", "space-between", "space-around", "space-evenly"], value)
    if prop == "align-items"
        return has_text(["stretch", "start", "end", "center"], value)
    if prop == "align-self"
        return has_text(["auto", "stretch", "start", "end", "center"], value)
    if has_text(["width", "height", "flex-basis"], prop)
        return value == "auto" or natural_token(value) or percent_token(value)
    if prop == "min-width" or prop == "min-height"
        return natural_token(value) or percent_token(value)
    if prop == "max-width" or prop == "max-height"
        return value == "none" or natural_token(value) or percent_token(value)
    if prop.starts_with("border-")
        return value == "0" or value == "1"
    if has_text(["top", "right", "bottom", "left"], prop)
        return value == "auto" or signed_token(value)
    if prop == "order"
        return signed_token(value)
    return natural_token(value)

class Declaration(string prop, string value)

Declaration[] expand_declaration(string prop, string value)
    tokens := value.split(" ")
    if style_get(default_style(), prop) != ""
        return if longhand_valid(prop, tokens) then [Declaration(prop, value)] else []
    if prop == "gap"
        if #tokens > 2
            return []
        for token := tokens[]
            if not natural_token(token)
                return []
        return [Declaration("row-gap", tokens[0]), Declaration("column-gap", tokens[-1])]
    if has_text(["margin", "padding", "border"], prop)
        if #tokens > 4
            return []
        for token := tokens[]
            if not longhand_valid(prop + "-top", [token])
                return []
        nat[][] picks := [[0, 0, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0, 1], [0, 1, 2, 1], [0, 1, 2, 3]]
        sides := ["top", "right", "bottom", "left"]
        return [for i := (nat(0):<4)[] then Declaration(prop + "-" + sides[i], tokens[picks[#tokens - 1][i]])]
    return []

int gap_total(int gap, nat count)
    return gap * (if count == 0 then 0 else int(count) - 1)

int[] distribute(int total, int[] weights)
    denominator := total_ints(weights)
    shares := [for weight := weights[] then total * weight / denominator]
    remainder := total - total_ints(shares)
    for: i < #weights
        if remainder > 0 and weights[i] > 0
            shares[i] += 1
            remainder -= 1
    return shares

int align_offset(string align, int free)
    return if free <= 0 then 0 else (if align == "end" then free else (if align == "center" then free / 2 else 0))

string[] wrap_words(string text, int available)
    string[] result := []
    for word := text.split(" ")[]
        if #result > 0 and int(#result[-1]) + 1 + int(#word) <= available
            result[-1] += " " + word
        else
            result = result.append(word)
    return result

class CssNode(string tag, string id, string[] classes, string text, int parent, nat depth)
    nat[] children := []
    style := default_style()
    displayed := false
    cw := 0
    ch := 0
    string[] lines := []
    rx := 0
    ry := 0
    x := 0
    y := 0

class Rule(string[] selectors, Declaration[] declarations)
class Area(int row, int column, int row_span, int column_span)
class Placement(Area[] areas, int columns)
class Contribution(int start, int span, int amount)
class GridLine(int start, int span)
class CssBox(int x, int y, int w, int h)
class FlexItem(nat index, string align, int outside, int cross, int base, int hypothetical, size := 0)

GridLine grid_request(string value)
    tokens := value.split(" ")
    if tokens[0] == "auto"
        return GridLine(0, 1)
    if tokens[0] == "span"
        return GridLine(0, int(tokens[1]))
    a := int(tokens[0])
    if #tokens == 1
        return GridLine(a, 1)
    int span := if tokens[2] == "span" then int(tokens[3]) else int(tokens[2]) - a
    return GridLine(a, span)

bool area_fits(Area[] placed, int row, int column, int row_span, int column_span)
    for other := placed[]
        if other.row != 0 and row < other.row + other.row_span and other.row < row + row_span and column < other.column + other.column_span and other.column < column + column_span
            return false
    return true

int span_start(int[] sizes, int start, int gap)
    return total_ints(sizes[:<start - 1]) + gap * (start - 1)

int span_size(int[] sizes, int start, int span, int gap)
    return total_ints(sizes[start - 1:<start - 1 + span]) + gap * (span - 1)

int[] track_sizes(string[] specs, int count, int available, int gap, Contribution[] contributions)
    tracks := specs
    while int(#tracks) < count
        tracks = tracks.append("auto")
    sizes := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then 0]
    for: i < #tracks
        spec := tracks[i]
        if spec == "auto" or (spec.ends_with("fr") and available < 0)
            for entry := contributions[]
                if entry.start == int(i) + 1 and entry.span == 1
                    sizes[i] = maximum(sizes[i], entry.amount)
        elif not spec.ends_with("fr")
            sizes[i] = int(spec)
    if available >= 0
        leftover := available - total_ints(sizes) - gap * (count - 1)
        int[] weights := [for spec := tracks[] then if spec.ends_with("fr") then int(spec[:<#spec - 2]) else 0]
        if total_ints(weights) == 0
            weights = [for spec := tracks[] then if spec == "auto" then 1 else 0]
        if leftover > 0 and total_ints(weights) > 0
            shares := distribute(leftover, weights)
            for: i < #sizes
                sizes[i] += shares[i]
    return sizes

string box_text(CssBox box)
    return "{box.x} {box.y} {box.w} {box.h}"

class Document(int viewport_width, int viewport_height, CssNode[] nodes)
    int[] intrinsic := []

    string property(nat index, string prop)
        return style_get(nodes[index].style, prop)

    int edge(nat index, string kind, string side)
        return int(property(index, kind + "-" + side))

    int frame(nat index, bool horizontal)
        string[] sides := if horizontal then ["left", "right"] else ["top", "bottom"]
        total := 0
        for side := sides[]
            total += edge(index, "padding", side) + edge(index, "border", side)
        return total

    int outer(nat index, bool horizontal)
        return frame(index, horizontal) + edge(index, "margin", if horizontal then "left" else "top") + edge(index, "margin", if horizontal then "right" else "bottom")

    int border_width(nat index)
        return nodes[index].cw + frame(index, true)

    int border_height(nat index)
        return nodes[index].ch + frame(index, false)

    nat[] flow_children(nat index)
        nat[] result := []
        for item := nodes[index].children[]
            if nodes[item].displayed and property(item, "position") != "absolute"
                result = result.append(item)
        return result

    nat[] ordered_items(nat index)
        nat[] result := []
        for item := flow_children(index)[]
            item_order := int(property(item, "order"))
            nat at := 0
            while at < #result and int(property(result[at], "order")) <= item_order
                at += 1
            result = result[:<at].append(item).concat(result[at:])
        return result

    int resolve_length(nat index, string prop, int reference, bool horizontal)
        string value := property(index, prop)
        if value == "auto" or value == "none"
            return -1
        result := 0
        if value.ends_with("%")
            if reference < 0
                return -1
            result = reference * int(value[:<#value - 1]) / 100
        else
            result = int(value)
        if property(index, "box-sizing") == "border-box"
            result = maximum(result - frame(index, horizontal), 0)
        return result

    int constrain(nat index, int value, bool horizontal, int reference)
        axis := if horizontal then "width" else "height"
        lower := maximum(resolve_length(index, "min-" + axis, reference, horizontal), 0)
        int upper := resolve_length(index, "max-" + axis, reference, horizontal)
        return maximum(if upper < 0 then value else minimum(value, upper), lower)

    int inset(nat index, string side)
        string value := property(index, side)
        return if value == "auto" then 0 else int(value)

    string item_align(nat container, nat item)
        string align := property(item, "align-self")
        return if align == "auto" then property(container, "align-items") else align

    void .place_child(nat container, nat item, int left, int top)
        nodes[item].rx = edge(container, "border", "left") + edge(container, "padding", "left") + left
        nodes[item].ry = edge(container, "border", "top") + edge(container, "padding", "top") + top

    string[] track_specs(nat index, string prop)
        string value := property(index, prop)
        return if value == "none" then [] else value.split(" ")

    string[] column_specs(nat index)
        string[] result := track_specs(index, "grid-template-columns")
        return if #result == 0 then ["auto"] else result

    Placement grid_placement(nat container, nat[] ordered)
        requested_rows := [for item := ordered[] then grid_request(property(item, "grid-row"))]
        requested_columns := [for item := ordered[] then grid_request(property(item, "grid-column"))]
        count := int(#column_specs(container))
        Area[] areas := []
        for: i < #ordered
            request := requested_columns[i]
            count = maximum(count, if request.start == 0 then request.span else request.start + request.span - 1)
            areas = areas.append(Area(0, 0, 0, 0))
        for: i < #ordered
            r := requested_rows[i]
            c := requested_columns[i]
            if r.start != 0 and c.start != 0
                areas[i] = Area(r.start, c.start, r.span, c.span)
        cursor_row := 1
        cursor_column := 1
        for: i < #ordered
            r := requested_rows[i]
            c := requested_columns[i]
            if r.start != 0 and c.start != 0
                continue
            row := r.start
            column := c.start
            if row != 0
                column = 1
                for: 1 <= candidate <= count - c.span + 1
                    if area_fits(areas, row, candidate, r.span, c.span)
                        column = candidate
                        break
            elif column != 0
                if column < cursor_column
                    cursor_row += 1
                row = cursor_row
                while not area_fits(areas, row, column, r.span, c.span)
                    row += 1
                cursor_row = row
                cursor_column = column + c.span
            else
                row = cursor_row
                column = cursor_column
                while true
                    if column + c.span - 1 > count
                        row += 1
                        column = 1
                    elif not area_fits(areas, row, column, r.span, c.span)
                        column += 1
                    else
                        break
                cursor_row = row
                cursor_column = column + c.span
            areas[i] = Area(row, column, r.span, c.span)
        return Placement(areas, count)

    int .max_content(nat index)
        if intrinsic[index] >= 0
            return intrinsic[index]
        result := 0
        if nodes[index].text != ""
            result = int(#nodes[index].text)
        elif property(index, "display") == "flex" and has_text(["row", "row-reverse"], property(index, "flex-direction"))
            nat[] child_ids := flow_children(index)
            for item := child_ids[]
                result += .width_contribution(item)
            result += gap_total(int(property(index, "column-gap")), #child_ids)
        elif property(index, "display") == "grid"
            nat[] ordered := ordered_items(index)
            Placement placement := grid_placement(index, ordered)
            Contribution[] contributions := []
            for: i < #ordered
                area := placement.areas[i]
                contributions = contributions.append(Contribution(area.column, area.column_span, .width_contribution(ordered[i])))
            gap := int(property(index, "column-gap"))
            result = total_ints(track_sizes(column_specs(index), placement.columns, -1, gap, contributions)) + gap_total(gap, nat(placement.columns))
        else
            for item := flow_children(index)[]
                result = maximum(result, .width_contribution(item))
        intrinsic[index] = result
        return result

    int .width_contribution(nat index)
        int value := resolve_length(index, "width", -1, true)
        if value < 0
            value = .max_content(index)
        return constrain(index, value, true, -1) + outer(index, true)

    int .layout_node(nat index, int cwref, int chref, fw := -1, fh := -1)
        if fw < 0
            int value := resolve_length(index, "width", cwref, true)
            fw = constrain(index, if value < 0 then maximum(cwref - outer(index, true), 0) else value, true, cwref)
        if fh < 0
            int value := resolve_length(index, "height", chref, false)
            if value >= 0
                fh = constrain(index, value, false, chref)
        nodes[index].cw = fw
        natural_height := 0
        if nodes[index].text != ""
            nodes[index].lines = wrap_words(nodes[index].text, fw)
            natural_height = int(#nodes[index].lines)
        elif property(index, "display") == "flex"
            natural_height = .flex_layout(index, fw, fh, chref)
        elif property(index, "display") == "grid"
            natural_height = .grid_layout(index, fw, fh)
        else
            bottom := 0
            previous := 0
            for item := flow_children(index)[]
                .layout_node(item, fw, fh)
                top := bottom + maximum(previous, edge(item, "margin", "top"))
                .place_child(index, item, edge(item, "margin", "left"), top)
                bottom = top + border_height(item)
                previous = edge(item, "margin", "bottom")
            natural_height = bottom + previous
        nodes[index].ch = if fh < 0 then constrain(index, natural_height, false, chref) else fh
        return natural_height

    FlexItem[] resolve_sizes(FlexItem[] line, int main_length, int gap, bool horizontal, int reference)
        gaps := gap_total(gap, #line)
        used := gaps
        for item := line[]
            used += item.hypothetical + item.outside
        growing := used < main_length
        int[] weights := []
        bool[] active := []
        for item := line[]
            int weight := int(property(item.index, if growing then "flex-grow" else "flex-shrink")) * (if growing then 1 else item.base)
            weights = weights.append(weight)
            active = active.append(weight > 0 and (if growing then item.base <= item.hypothetical else item.base >= item.hypothetical))
        for: i < #line
            line[i].size = line[i].hypothetical
        while true
            nat[] unfrozen := []
            free := main_length - gaps
            for: i < #line
                if active[i]
                    unfrozen = unfrozen.append(i)
                free -= (if active[i] then line[i].base else line[i].size) + line[i].outside
            if #unfrozen == 0
                break
            shares := distribute(maximum(if growing then free else -free, 0), [for i := unfrozen[] then weights[i]])
            violations := [for i := (nat(0):<#line)[] then 0]
            for: at < #unfrozen
                i := unfrozen[at]
                tentative := line[i].base + (if growing then shares[at] else -shares[at])
                line[i].size = constrain(line[i].index, tentative, horizontal, reference)
                violations[i] = line[i].size - tentative
            total := total_ints(violations)
            for i := unfrozen[]
                if total == 0 or (total > 0 and violations[i] > 0) or (total < 0 and violations[i] < 0)
                    active[i] = false
        return line

    int[] justify_spaces(string justify, int remaining, nat count)
        spaces := [for i := (0:<nat(count))[] then 0]
        if remaining <= 0 or justify == "start"
            return spaces
        if justify == "end"
            spaces[0] = remaining
        elif justify == "center"
            spaces[0] = remaining / 2
        else
            ends := if justify == "space-between" then 0 else 1
            middle := if justify == "space-around" then 2 else 1
            int[] weights := [ends].concat([for i := (0:<nat(count - 1))[] then middle]).append(ends)
            if total_ints(weights) > 0
                spaces = distribute(remaining, weights)[:<count]
        return spaces

    int .flex_layout(nat index, int cwref, int k, int height_reference)
        string direction := property(index, "flex-direction")
        horizontal := has_text(["row", "row-reverse"], direction)
        gap := int(property(index, if horizontal then "column-gap" else "row-gap"))
        row_gap := int(property(index, "row-gap"))
        reference := if horizontal then cwref else k
        FlexItem[] all_items := []
        for item := ordered_items(index)[]
            string align := item_align(index, item)
            cross := 0
            if not horizontal
                room := maximum(cwref - outer(item, true), 0)
                cross = resolve_length(item, "width", cwref, true)
                if cross < 0
                    cross = if align == "stretch" then room else minimum(.max_content(item), room)
                cross = constrain(item, cross, true, cwref)
            int base := resolve_length(item, "flex-basis", reference, horizontal)
            if base < 0
                base = resolve_length(item, if horizontal then "width" else "height", reference, horizontal)
            if base < 0
                base = if horizontal then .max_content(item) else .layout_node(item, cwref, k, cross)
            all_items = all_items.append(FlexItem(item, align, outer(item, horizontal), cross, base, constrain(item, base, horizontal, reference)))
        main_length := if horizontal then cwref else k
        if main_length < 0
            main_length = gap_total(gap, #all_items)
            for item := all_items[]
                main_length += item.hypothetical + item.outside
            main_length = constrain(index, main_length, false, height_reference)
        FlexItem[][] lines := []
        if horizontal and property(index, "flex-wrap") == "wrap"
            for item := all_items[]
                appended := false
                if #lines > 0
                    last := #lines - 1
                    used := gap * int(#lines[last]) + item.hypothetical + item.outside
                    for other := lines[last][]
                        used += other.hypothetical + other.outside
                    if used <= main_length
                        lines[last] = lines[last].append(item)
                        appended = true
                if not appended
                    lines = lines.append([item])
        elif #all_items > 0
            lines = [all_items]
        cross_start := 0
        total_cross := 0
        for raw_line := lines[]
            FlexItem[] line := resolve_sizes(raw_line, main_length, gap, horizontal, reference)
            lc := cwref
            if horizontal
                largest := 0
                for: i < #line
                    .layout_node(line[i].index, cwref, k, line[i].size)
                    line[i].cross = nodes[line[i].index].ch
                    largest = maximum(largest, line[i].cross + outer(line[i].index, false))
                lc = if #lines > 1 then largest else (if k >= 0 then k else constrain(index, largest, false, height_reference))
            remaining := main_length - gap_total(gap, #line)
            for item := line[]
                remaining -= item.size + item.outside
            int[] spaces := justify_spaces(property(index, "justify-content"), remaining, #line)
            backwards := direction.ends_with("-reverse")
            cursor := if backwards then main_length else 0
            for: i < #line
                item := line[i]
                amount := item.size + item.outside
                main_position := 0
                if backwards
                    cursor -= spaces[i] + amount
                    main_position = cursor
                    cursor -= gap
                else
                    cursor += spaces[i]
                    main_position = cursor
                    cursor += amount + gap
                main_position += edge(item.index, "margin", if horizontal then "left" else "top")
                if not horizontal
                    .layout_node(item.index, cwref, k, item.cross, item.size)
                elif item.align == "stretch" and property(item.index, "height") == "auto"
                    item.cross = constrain(item.index, maximum(lc - outer(item.index, false), 0), false, k)
                    .layout_node(item.index, cwref, k, item.size, item.cross)
                else
                    .layout_node(item.index, cwref, k, item.size)
                offset := align_offset(item.align, lc - item.cross - outer(item.index, not horizontal))
                if horizontal
                    .place_child(index, item.index, main_position, cross_start + offset + edge(item.index, "margin", "top"))
                else
                    .place_child(index, item.index, cross_start + offset + edge(item.index, "margin", "left"), main_position)
            total_cross += lc
            cross_start += lc + row_gap
        return if horizontal then total_cross + gap_total(row_gap, #lines) else main_length

    int .grid_layout(nat index, int cwref, int k)
        nat[] ordered := ordered_items(index)
        Placement placement := grid_placement(index, ordered)
        cg := int(property(index, "column-gap"))
        rg := int(property(index, "row-gap"))
        Contribution[] column_contributions := []
        for: i < #ordered
            area := placement.areas[i]
            column_contributions = column_contributions.append(Contribution(area.column, area.column_span, .width_contribution(ordered[i])))
        columns := track_sizes(column_specs(index), placement.columns, cwref, cg, column_contributions)
        int[] area_widths := []
        int[] widths := []
        Contribution[] row_contributions := []
        for: i < #ordered
            item := ordered[i]
            area := placement.areas[i]
            aw := span_size(columns, area.column, area.column_span, cg)
            int value := resolve_length(item, "width", aw, true)
            int gw := constrain(item, if value < 0 then maximum(aw - outer(item, true), 0) else value, true, aw)
            .layout_node(item, aw, -1, gw)
            area_widths = area_widths.append(aw)
            widths = widths.append(gw)
            row_contributions = row_contributions.append(Contribution(area.row, area.row_span, nodes[item].ch + outer(item, false)))
        string[] specs := track_specs(index, "grid-template-rows")
        nr := int(#specs)
        for area := placement.areas[]
            nr = maximum(nr, area.row + area.row_span - 1)
        rows := track_sizes(specs, nr, k, rg, row_contributions)
        for: i < #ordered
            item := ordered[i]
            area := placement.areas[i]
            ah := span_size(rows, area.row, area.row_span, rg)
            string align := item_align(index, item)
            if align == "stretch" and property(item, "height") == "auto"
                int fh := constrain(item, maximum(ah - outer(item, false), 0), false, ah)
                .layout_node(item, area_widths[i], ah, widths[i], fh)
            else
                .layout_node(item, area_widths[i], ah, widths[i])
            offset := align_offset(align, ah - nodes[item].ch - outer(item, false))
            .place_child(index, item, span_start(columns, area.column, cg) + edge(item, "margin", "left"), span_start(rows, area.row, rg) + offset + edge(item, "margin", "top"))
        return total_ints(rows) + gap_total(rg, nat(nr))

    int positioned_ancestor(nat index)
        result := nodes[index].parent
        while result >= 0 and property(nat(result), "position") == "static"
            result = nodes[result].parent
        return result

    CssBox border_box(nat index)
        return CssBox(nodes[index].x, nodes[index].y, border_width(index), border_height(index))

    CssBox margin_box(nat index)
        return CssBox(nodes[index].x - edge(index, "margin", "left"), nodes[index].y - edge(index, "margin", "top"), nodes[index].cw + outer(index, true), nodes[index].ch + outer(index, false))

    CssBox padding_box(nat index)
        return CssBox(nodes[index].x + edge(index, "border", "left"), nodes[index].y + edge(index, "border", "top"), nodes[index].cw + edge(index, "padding", "left") + edge(index, "padding", "right"), nodes[index].ch + edge(index, "padding", "top") + edge(index, "padding", "bottom"))

    CssBox content_box(nat index)
        CssBox box := padding_box(index)
        return CssBox(box.x + edge(index, "padding", "left"), box.y + edge(index, "padding", "top"), nodes[index].cw, nodes[index].ch)

    void .perform_layout()
        intrinsic = [for i := (nat(0):<#nodes)[] then -1]
        for: i < #nodes
            nodes[i].displayed = property(i, "display") != "none" and (nodes[i].parent < 0 or nodes[nodes[i].parent].displayed)
        if nodes[0].displayed and property(0, "position") != "absolute"
            .layout_node(0, viewport_width, viewport_height)
            nodes[0].rx = edge(0, "margin", "left")
            nodes[0].ry = edge(0, "margin", "top")
        for: i < #nodes
            if not nodes[i].displayed or property(i, "position") != "absolute"
                continue
            int ancestor_id := positioned_ancestor(i)
            int bw := if ancestor_id < 0 then viewport_width else padding_box(nat(ancestor_id)).w
            int bh := if ancestor_id < 0 then viewport_height else padding_box(nat(ancestor_id)).h
            has_left := property(i, "left") != "auto"
            has_right := property(i, "right") != "auto"
            has_top := property(i, "top") != "auto"
            has_bottom := property(i, "bottom") != "auto"
            int left := inset(i, "left")
            int right := inset(i, "right")
            int top := inset(i, "top")
            int bottom := inset(i, "bottom")
            int w := resolve_length(i, "width", bw, true)
            if w < 0
                room := maximum(bw - left - right - outer(i, true), 0)
                w = if has_left and has_right then room else minimum(.max_content(i), room)
            int fw := constrain(i, w, true, bw)
            fh := -1
            if property(i, "height") == "auto" and has_top and has_bottom
                fh = constrain(i, maximum(bh - top - bottom - outer(i, false), 0), false, bh)
            .layout_node(i, bw, bh, fw, fh)
            nodes[i].rx = if has_left then left + edge(i, "margin", "left") else (if has_right then bw - right - edge(i, "margin", "right") - border_width(i) else edge(i, "margin", "left"))
            nodes[i].ry = if has_top then top + edge(i, "margin", "top") else (if has_bottom then bh - bottom - edge(i, "margin", "bottom") - border_height(i) else edge(i, "margin", "top"))
        for: i < #nodes
            if not nodes[i].displayed
                continue
            absolute_position := property(i, "position") == "absolute"
            int ancestor_id := if absolute_position then positioned_ancestor(i) else nodes[i].parent
            ox := 0
            oy := 0
            if ancestor_id >= 0
                CssBox origin := if absolute_position then padding_box(nat(ancestor_id)) else border_box(nat(ancestor_id))
                ox = origin.x
                oy = origin.y
            nodes[i].x = ox + nodes[i].rx
            nodes[i].y = oy + nodes[i].ry
            if property(i, "position") == "relative"
                nodes[i].x += if property(i, "left") != "auto" then inset(i, "left") else -inset(i, "right")
                nodes[i].y += if property(i, "top") != "auto" then inset(i, "top") else -inset(i, "bottom")

    string[] snapshot()
        return [for i := (nat(0):<#nodes)[] then if nodes[i].displayed then box_text(border_box(i)) else "none"]

    string changes(string[] before)
        string[] after := snapshot()
        string[] changed := []
        for: i < #nodes
            if before[i] != after[i]
                changed = changed.append(nodes[i].id)
        return if #changed == 0 then "no change" else changed.join(" ")

    bool overflows(nat index)
        if nodes[index].text != ""
            longest := 0
            for line := nodes[index].lines[]
                longest = maximum(longest, int(#line))
            return longest > nodes[index].cw or int(#nodes[index].lines) > nodes[index].ch
        CssBox box := content_box(index)
        for item := flow_children(index)[]
            CssBox child_box := margin_box(item)
            if child_box.x < box.x or child_box.y < box.y or child_box.x + child_box.w > box.x + box.w or child_box.y + child_box.h > box.y + box.h
                return true
        return false

    void render_screen()
        screen := [for row := (0:<int(viewport_height))[] then [for column := (0:<int(viewport_width))[] then "."]]
        for: i < #nodes
            if not nodes[i].displayed
                continue
            CssBox box := border_box(i)
            for: maximum(box.y, 0) <= row < minimum(box.y + box.h, viewport_height)
                for: maximum(box.x, 0) <= column < minimum(box.x + box.w, viewport_width)
                    on_row := (edge(i, "border", "top") == 1 and row == box.y) or (edge(i, "border", "bottom") == 1 and row == box.y + box.h - 1)
                    on_column := (edge(i, "border", "left") == 1 and column == box.x) or (edge(i, "border", "right") == 1 and column == box.x + box.w - 1)
                    screen[row][column] = if on_row then (if on_column then "+" else "-") else (if on_column then "|" else " ")
            if nodes[i].text != ""
                CssBox content := content_box(i)
                for: row < #nodes[i].lines
                    line := nodes[i].lines[row]
                    for: column < #line
                        x := content.x + int(column)
                        y := content.y + int(row)
                        if x >= 0 and x < viewport_width and y >= 0 and y < viewport_height
                            screen[y][x] = line[column]
        emit("render {viewport_width}x{viewport_height}")
        string boundary := "#" * nat(viewport_width + 2)
        emit(boundary)
        for row := screen[]
            emit("#" + row.join("") + "#")
        emit(boundary)

    void .execute(string line)
        parts := line.split(" ")
        command := parts[0]
        if command == "LAYOUT"
            emit("layout {viewport_width}x{viewport_height}")
            for: i < #nodes
                emit(" " * (2 * nodes[i].depth) + nodes[i].id + " " + (if nodes[i].displayed then box_text(border_box(i)) else "none"))
        elif command == "BOX" or command == "SET"
            id := parts[1]
            found := -1
            for: i < #nodes
                if nodes[i].id == id
                    found = int(i)
                    break
            if found < 0
                emit("error: unknown element " + id)
                return
            index := nat(found)
            if command == "BOX"
                if not nodes[index].displayed
                    emit("box " + id + ": none")
                else
                    emit("box " + id)
                    emit("margin " + box_text(margin_box(index)))
                    emit("border " + box_text(border_box(index)))
                    emit("padding " + box_text(padding_box(index)))
                    emit("content " + box_text(content_box(index)))
            else
                prop := parts[2]
                value := parts[3:].join(" ")
                if not known_property(prop)
                    emit("error: unknown property " + prop)
                    return
                declarations := expand_declaration(prop, value)
                if #declarations == 0
                    emit("error: invalid value for " + prop + ": " + value)
                    return
                string[] before := snapshot()
                for declaration := declarations[]
                    .nodes[index].style.set(declaration.prop, declaration.value)
                .perform_layout()
                emit("set " + id + " " + prop + " " + value + ": " + changes(before))
        elif command == "RENDER"
            render_screen()
        elif command == "HIT"
            x := int(parts[1])
            y := int(parts[2])
            if x >= viewport_width or y >= viewport_height
                emit("error: point {x} {y} outside viewport")
                return
            target := -1
            for: i < #nodes
                CssBox box := border_box(i)
                if nodes[i].displayed and x >= box.x and x < box.x + box.w and y >= box.y and y < box.y + box.h
                    target = int(i)
            string[] path := []
            while target >= 0
                path = [nodes[target].id].concat(path)
                target = nodes[target].parent
            emit("hit {x} {y}: " + (if #path == 0 then "none" else path.join(" > ")))
        elif command == "VIEWPORT"
            w := int(parts[1])
            h := int(parts[2])
            if w < 1 or w > 80 or h < 1 or h > 40
                emit("error: invalid viewport {w} {h}")
                return
            string[] before := snapshot()
            viewport_width = w
            viewport_height = h
            .perform_layout()
            emit("viewport {w} {h}: " + changes(before))
        elif command == "OVERFLOW"
            string[] ids := []
            for: i < #nodes
                if nodes[i].displayed and overflows(i)
                    ids = ids.append(nodes[i].id)
            emit("overflow: " + (if #ids == 0 then "none" else ids.join(" ")))
        else
            emit("error: unknown command " + command)

void run_program()
    line := ""
    scan(&line)
    dimensions := line.split(" ")
    Rule[] rules := []
    while true
        scan(&line)
        if line == "---"
            break
        boundary := find_text(line, " {{ ")
        selectors := line[:<boundary].split(", ")
        body := line[boundary + 3:<#line - 2]
        Declaration[] declarations := []
        for declaration := body.split("; ")[]
            colon := find_text(declaration, ": ")
            declarations = declarations.concat(expand_declaration(declaration[:<colon], declaration[colon + 2:]))
        rules = rules.append(Rule(selectors, declarations))
    CssNode[] elements := []
    nat[] stack := []
    while true
        scan(&line)
        if line == "==="
            break
        nat spaces := 0
        while spaces < #line and line[spaces] == " "
            spaces += 1
        depth := spaces / 2
        rest := line[spaces:]
        nat head_end := 0
        while head_end < #rest and rest[head_end] != " "
            head_end += 1
        head := rest[:<head_end]
        text := if head_end == #rest then "" else rest[head_end + 2:<#rest - 1]
        hash_at := find_text(head, "#")
        names := head[hash_at + 1:].split(".")
        stack = stack[:<depth]
        parent := if #stack == 0 then -1 else int(stack[-1])
        node := CssNode(head[:<hash_at], names[0], names[1:], text, parent, depth)
        map<string, int> winners
        for rule := rules[]
            specificity := -1
            for selector := rule.selectors[]
                score := -1
                if selector.starts_with("#")
                    if selector[1:] == node.id
                        score = 2
                elif selector.starts_with(".")
                    if has_text(node.classes, selector[1:])
                        score = 1
                elif selector == node.tag
                    score = 0
                specificity = maximum(specificity, score)
            if specificity < 0
                continue
            for declaration := rule.declarations[]
                previous := -1
                match winners.get(declaration.prop)
                    int entry
                        previous = entry
                    none
                        void
                if specificity >= previous
                    .winners.set(declaration.prop, specificity)
                    .node.style.set(declaration.prop, declaration.value)
        index := #elements
        elements = elements.append(node)
        if parent >= 0
            elements[parent].children = elements[parent].children.append(index)
        stack = stack.append(index)
    document := Document(int(dimensions[0]), int(dimensions[1]), elements)
    .document.perform_layout()
    while true
        scan(&line)
        if line == "END"
            break
        .document.execute(line)

run_program()
